description: The chart represents the distribution of various layers and their subcategories in a circular pie chart. The chart is divided into 3 main categories and 14 subcategories. The three main categories are Signal Layer (4.3%, light gray), Semantic Layer (41.2%, light blue), and Perception Layer (40.4%, dark blue), with the remaining proportion labeled as Analysis (approximately 14%, gray). The subcategories under Signal Layer include Anomaly Detection Acoustic Quality Analysis and Imagination Culture of Speaker, under Semantic Layer are Content Analysis, Emotion & Intention, and Speaker Analysis, and under Perception Layer are Environmental Perception & Reasoning, Counting & Statistics, Music Theory, Correlation Analysis, Temporal Analysis, and Spatial Analysis, with some subcategories further divided. The chart includes percentage labels for the main categories and uses different shades of blue and gray to distinguish between the categories, with labels placed inside or adjacent to their respective sections, and no legend is present. The sections appear to be ordered in a clockwise direction, with the largest sections, Semantic Layer and Perception Layer, adjacent to each other.
